glazelite: Fast JSON Reading and Writing with the Glaze C++ Library

Source: R/glazelite-package.R
glazelite-package.Rd

glazelite reads and writes JSON using the header-only C++ library Glaze by Stephen Berry. It offers a subset of the 'jsonlite' interface:

Details

  • jsonlite::toJSON() and jsonlite::fromJSON() convert between R objects and JSON text.

  • jsonlite::write_json() and jsonlite::read_json() work directly on files. Writing is incremental, so a document may be larger than a single R string.

  • jsonlite::stream_out() and jsonlite::stream_in() write and read newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) in batches.

  • jsonlite::prettify(), jsonlite::minify() and jsonlite::validate() reformat and check JSON text, and jsonlite::unbox() marks single values that are written as scalars.

Credits

All JSON encoding and parsing is done by Glaze, which is bundled with the package under the MIT license. Glaze in turn includes code from the 'fast_float', 'zmij' and 'xxh64' projects. See the file COPYRIGHTS in the installed package for details.
